page.overview:
Who is Lucy?

Lucy was a female Velociraptor that could be seen at the Raptor Encounter attraction at Universal's Islands of Adventure in Orlando, Florida, alongside another Velociraptor named Ethel. Lucy and Ethel were first shown off when the Raptor Encounter attraction opened on May 27, 2015

Guests would have the opportunity to meet either Lucy or Ethel and had the option to take photos with the raptor. Nearby handlers encouraged guests not to touch the raptor.
